summary: The legal integer has at most 30 binary digits, which is too narrow for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted implementation constructs and compares that bounded representation once.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted source creates at most 30 binary characters and compares each character with exactly one reversed position, establishing O(B) time across the complete legal width bound.

The dedicated regression compares the accepted adapter with independent mirrored bit extraction for every positive integer through 1,000,000 and deterministic values spanning every legal bit width through 10^9.
